title: A great tour to learn.
text: I didn't expect La Sagrada Familia has many symbolisms, I walked around and listen about the details and secrets that this iconic place has to offer. Viktoryia is very kind and has a great knowledge about Barcelona and this Church. She kindly took the time for me to contemplate, listen and take photos. I recommend this great tour to enrich yourself as a traveler and get more information about this place.
author: Monito_P

title: Thanks to Krizstina
text: Krizstina was simply fabulous. She is experienced and enthusiastic. She explained plenty of information about Sagrada Familia and the city's history.
author: trip-radar
